one_liner.zh: 通过 DSH 接入 Gemini 网页端的 MCP 工具
one_liner.en: MCP tools for Gemini web, connected through DSH

accounts: Google account signed in to gemini.google.com

external_services.purpose: Send prompts and files, retrieve Gemini replies, and manage conversations through the web interface

local: Python 3.10 or newer and uv are required by the documented launch path.
A logged-in Chrome, Edge, or Chromium profile, or an exported cookies JSON file, is needed.
Generated media is downloaded to the configured save directory (default ./media).

config_items.name: GEMINI_HTTP_TOKEN
config_items.description: Bearer token for HTTP transport; generated when not configured

completeness.reason: Server registers chat, media analysis and generation, conversation management, download, and status tools.

code.reason: Client and server are separated, use typed data classes and validate key inputs; response parsing has fallbacks.

docs.reason: README documents setup, cookie choices, DSH wiring, tool list, operation, and troubleshooting.

maintenance.reason: The repository has 18 commits and was last pushed on 2026-08-24, over 30 days before assessment.

tests.reason: Three test modules cover auth, cookie extraction, and client behavior; quality facts report 0 test files, so score reflects the visible tests only.
